policy: Actual active contracts and cumulative registers only. A productive lemma never licenses untaught forms, senses or constructions. All 14 JSON contracts loaded in full and audited for outcomes, boundaries and assignment status; task-level checks use actual form/sense/feature records.

productive_outcomes: Use the assigned lexical gender; do not infer it from English or from a bare nominative ending alone.
Coordinate nominal phrases with and; each article agrees with its own head.
Strong masculine consonant stems: complete N/G/D/A singular and plural; assign only the listed lexical senses.
Strong masculine -e: replace the nominative -e appropriately; no invented mętees.
Complete dæg and hwæl patterns, with æ in singular and a in plural; do not extend to clusters such as wæstm.
Complete selected fugol and morgen patterns; loss of medial vowel with endings and lexical diagnostic forms. Source variants remain valid.
Complete hof and sǣd patterns; short-stem monosyllabic neuter N/A plural -u versus heavy-stem zero; explain geminates and clusters.
Complete trēo paradigm with w before endings and selected exceptional N/A plural trēowu.
Complete selected ǣfen, tācen, wæter, nīeten patterns; retain or syncopate medial vowel as documented, not by an unrestricted weight rule.
Complete long-stem strong feminine pattern; selected N/A plural -a, with source -e variants noted separately.
Complete selected tīd and wyrt patterns; endingless accusative singular despite ordinary -e feminine obliques.
Complete -nes pattern; -ness- in obliques/plural, retaining e; apply to each listed diagnostic stem.
Complete selected -ung/-ing feminine pattern, productive -e singular obliques; source -a variants separately noted.
Complete weak masculine steorra and weak feminine eorðe patterns; contrast all singular/plural cases.
Complete mann: męnn dative singular and nominative/accusative plural; other selected cases as listed.
Complete selected niht paradigm, including genitive singular niht and endingless nominative/accusative plural.
Complete selected sea table, with productive attested cells and explicitly supplied reconstructed genitive plural *sǣwa.
Complete selected plural-only darkness paradigm; no singular invented.
Produce the selected article forms agreeing with their own noun in gender, number and nominative/genitive/dative/accusative case.
Produce every person/number cell of the present eom/eart/is/sindon and preterite wæs/wǣre/wæs/wǣron indicative series.
Finite subjects and noun predicates identifying the subject are nominative; ordinary bare noun predicates need no translated indefinite article.
Use the copula's appropriate number/person in the taught ordinary clauses.
Produce limiting relational genitives. Follow Cook's exercise target: dependent first, head noun without its own article; retain the dependent's required article.
Select accusative direct-object noun/article forms in explicitly supplied transitive finite-verb frames.
Use taught locative on with dative ('in/on'); this is a selected construction, not a universal spatial rule.
Use fram plus dative for the entity from which something is separated, in an explicitly supplied separating frame.
Preserve the head's externally governed case while its own limiting dependent remains genitive; the genitive article belongs to that dependent.
Use a dative recipient and accusative thing given in the explicitly supplied sealde frame; distinguish to/for-recipient from the direct object.
recognition_outcomes: Recognize æ, interchangeable manuscript þ/ð, Cook's preference for ð, his hooked ę, and quantity marks; preserve exact printed quantities.
Distinguish long vowels/diphthongs from syllable weight due to two consonants or a geminate; apply only the stated noun-pattern domains.
Identical spellings may occupy different case/number cells; determine syntactic role from construction and agreement.
Recognize distinct instrumental masculine/neuter singular ðȳ and ðon as reference cells; no productive instrumental syntax.
Recognize that the opening On anginne gescēop God places the subject after the verb; parse by construction and forms, not English order alone.

productive_outcomes: Use complete personal N/D/A and third-person G forms, including duals and contextually justified reference.
Produce the complete present/preterite indicative morphology of22 affirmative weak verbs within separately stated lexical and syntactic scopes.
Compose affirmative and simple negative active clauses with taught subjects, accusative objects, giving recipients, invariant third-person possessors, reflexive resting and bounded direct quotation.
Read the two new connected texts using taught material and the exact Sabbath paragraph using its printed local supports.
recognition_outcomes: Recognize six first-/second-person personal genitives without assuming possessive-adjective inflection.
Recognize the complete12-cell nabban indicative companion.
Identify supplied infinitive/participle citations without independent recall or nonfinite syntax.
bounded_scope: Morphology-only diagnostic lemmas acquire no arbitrary object/complement syntax.
First/second genitives and nabban are recognition, not independent recall.
Nonfinite citations/source constructions marked supplied create no milestones.
Source variants are valid alternatives without assigned recall milestones.
No source numbered Cook exercise is assigned by this audit.

Full12 finite cells are stored even when a learner table combines allplural persons and past1/3sg. Dual pronoun subjects use corresponding plural verb forms; no separate dual finite endings are invented.
Selected forms are a coherent bounded target, not a claim that unselected source variants are erroneous.
First/second-person genitives are recognition-only; mīn/ðīn/ūre/ēower/uncer/incer as agreeing possessive adjectives and sīn/self are deferred.
his/hiere/hiera are invariant possessives; possessive choice follows possessor, not possessed noun gender/number/case.
Simple productive negation uses ne with noncontracting weak verbs. nabban companion is recognition-only; copula contractions not taught. Source allows ne hæbbe as well as næbbe, etc.

Morphology does not grant new government/complement frames. īecan, gierwan, ęfnan, hycgan diagnostic paradigms can be practised as isolated form selection; ēhtan is an unassigned source comparison, with no new government rule assigned.
No passive/perfect/infinitive/subjunctive/imperative mastery follows from principal-part citations or reading support.
Prefixed reading verbs are separately checked lexemes; no general ge- aspect or sense rule.

productive_outcomes: Use the complete strong/weak adjective NGDA systems and selected stem changes in ordinary attributive and predicate agreement.
Use six agreeing possessives, distinguishing possessor reference from the gender, number and case of the possessed noun.
Form and use six comparison series, selected adverb degrees, and bounded copular comparisons with a nominative standard after ðonne.
Use one through twelve in their stated count-noun frames, first through seventh as ordinals, and this/that demonstratives.
Complete Cook I.4.1–17 and original graded tasks, read the controlled account independently, and interpret the complete fourth-day source with its explicit local support.
recognition_outcomes: Identify displayed distinct instrumental forms without productive instrumental syntax.
Recognize plural ān morphology without a plural-count-one meaning.
Recognize the strong-only eall reference paradigm without productive quantifier syntax.
bounded_scope: Instrumental cells and plural ān are recognition/reference; they do not establish instrumental syntax or cardinal-one plural meaning.
Ordinary adjectives after possessives admit strong and sometimes weak; no universal possessive→weak rule.
Complete forms do not imply substantival, partitive, adverbial, participial, temporal or clause syntax beyond explicit features.
No general prefix rule, subjunctive/imperative production, perfect/passive production, or expanded comparative clause syntax.
eall strong-only reference cells/sense are new recognition; no independent production or general quantifier syntax.
Source-only connective sōðlice remains supplied despite the newly productive adverb truly sharing its invariant spelling.
All unselected variants are valid source alternatives, with no automatic extra milestones.
Audit cell recommendations are inputs to the learning contract, not assignments or milestones. Existing supplied histories remain intact.
NGDA forms and ordinary agreement are productive only where contract assigns them. Instrumental cells remain recognition reference; means/manner/measure syntax is not taught.
Agreeing possessive lemmas are separate from personal genitives. Invariant his/hiere/hiera remain the Unit2 system. sīn/self/relative uses are deferred.
eall is a new-recognition morphology reference exception, with no production or independent all-quantifier syntax. ān plural is morphological recognition only; alone is not assigned.
Other Cook comparison families, defective spatial/time degrees, higher numerals/fractions, inflected substantive4–19, and advanced comparison standards are outside this bounded unit.

Connected source-reading subjunctives, strong preterites, perfect/resultative/purpose constructions and lexical prefixed verbs require the source editor’s explicit support; adjective tables do not teach them.

bounded_scope: No numbered Cook set is assigned in Unit4.

No directional on rule, instrumental transport, productive prefix semantics or unbounded lexical government. No change to reference-only *sǣwa.
The source him antecedent is a contextual guiding inference, not a morphologically unique graded fact.

bounded_scope: No nonfinite syntax, mood, passive, perfect or auxiliary-system promotion from citation display.
No productive quantifier eall, reference instrumental, plural-cardinal-one or *sǣwa promotion.

Complete all72 original graded tasks, read the checked controlled dialogue independently, and interpret the exact fisherman excerpt with its explicitly bounded support.
recognition_outcomes: Distinguish actual usable forms from uncertain or unattested modal citation labels; no regular modal imperative or inflected infinitive is invented.

Distinguish selected course forms from valid documented alternatives and unassigned additional lexical rows.
bounded_scope: First/second personal genitives remain recognition-only; agreeing possessives are separate productive lemmas.
Instrumental forms, plural ān and eall remain recognition/reference; *sǣwa remains a supplied starred reconstruction without milestones.
Nabban, bregdan and fēolan remain at prior recognition scope; their presence in a prior table does not authorize productive new commands.
Diagnostic īecan, gierwan, ęfnan and hycgan lack arbitrary productive argument frames; use isolated form exercises unless a frame is expressly audited.
Hātan active indicative morphology does not teach hātte, infinitival causatives or double-accusative naming.
Beodan offer and lǣtan let do not automatically license command/causative complement frames; biddan ask needs an explicit new construction if used with an infinitive.

Simple ne negation extends only to newly audited systems; no negative copula, negative concord or every contracted negative form follows.
Participles, passive, subjunctive/optative wishes and unsupported subordinate moods remain supplied/deferred. Creation wishes must not be labelled imperative morphology.
No ge- or other prefix generalization; new prefixed lexemes need their own evidence.
I.4.18 and the birds candidate remain Unit7 deferrals; no earlier active artifact is rewritten.
Only43 imperative-model lemma systems (44 rows with alternate bēon) and two additional infinitive-only skill verbs receive these new nonfinite/imperative milestones.

No numbered Cook set is assigned; existing79 assigned/565 deferred items, I.4.18 and birds deferments persist.

bounded_scope: Course Units1–7 are the sole prior-teaching authority.

Direct questions and ordinary subject/object/dative relatives are productive. Main-clause and relative-clause cases are independently governed in the assigned model. Case attraction is a limited recognition note; embedded interrogatives and extended content-clause syntax remain later work.
Hwā/hwæt has singular common-personal and neuter columns only. The nominal instrumental reference forms do not establish general instrumental syntax; lexical hwȳ why is separately bounded.
Full hwilc, hwæðer and hūlic morphology supports ordinary direct interrogative uses; hwæðer is practised attributively with a supplied two-person context, without a new partitive construction.
Existing se/ðes morphology, eall and ǣlc, and ōðer second retain their actual prior milestones. New relative and other/another senses require explicit teaching.
New sum, ǣnig, gehwilc and swilc uses are ordinary attributive certain/some, any, each and such; ilca is weak only and self has complete strong/weak morphology with bounded emphasis/reflexive use.

Cook§89 indefinite ān a/certain, negative/either families, indeclinable anything/nothing families, -hwega formations and broad free-choice/partitive patterns are explicitly deferred to Unit15. Prior cardinal ān does not teach its indefinite sense.
Līf plural morphology is promoted for individual lives and the explicitly taught libban cognate-accusative frame. Gefyllan fill is distinct from finish/accomplish; prior supplied history is retained.

Ætēowian has complete assigned indicative and subjunctive systems; scīnan has complete new subjunctives; geblētsian has both new commands. Familiar verb headwords do not supply missing moods or commands.
The exact Cook hint gesęte remains supplied with a bounded placement-in-location explanation. No independent prefixed gesettan system is assigned.
The habban...on...gewealde control frame is taught separately from spatial on and under. Geweald singular is prior; its plural remains recognition-only.

All72 exact merchant words, four complete turns and15 original notes are retained. The12 local helps support source-only maritime vocabulary, content clause, useful-datives, correlator, collective hit and accompanying participle; those supplied dependencies are never tested for unaided recall.

The62word new dialogue and16 examples are declared new teaching material. Their public text has independent source and grammar checks; all answer models and ordered output tokens stay in the clearly named author-only file.

Reported statements and dependent questions commonly select subjunctive in the stated settings. Contextual indicative can be valid; subjunctive does not assert falsity. Simultaneous present/past reports do not teach an automatic English backshift or the whole later tense/sequence system.
Inflected interrogative hwæðer and invariant whether hwæðer remain distinct lemmas and senses. Wh forms take their function's case inside the dependent clause.

The three new noun classes have literal complete NGDA tables. Other new nouns use complete earlier-class models plus explicit lexical stems and diagnostics. Every derivative cell is mapped, not falsely certified as printed verbatim.
Manig is productive as plural attributive many. Its singular forms and unassigned mass/abstract count-plurals remain recognition reference; displaying them creates no unassigned sense or syntax.

All17 selected new verb indicatives, six command pairs and sēcan subjunctives are complete. Other new infinitive citations remain supplied except the separately productive wician preference complement.
Sēceað is the exact source command variant, recognized with help. Sēcað is the selected productive plural command. Local fēt does not follow productively from prefixed āfēdan.

The source's seems frames, passives, among phrases, comparative furðra, substantival address and feeding phrase retain local support. Nominative hwilc/furðra must not be forced into the command/perception accusative-actor model.

Every public input and private required output is identified by actual form/sense IDs. Deliberately erroneous correction inputs are labeled and do not certify their syntax as good Old English.

The independent reviewer solves the actual learner tasks before reading any listed private answer/model file, freezes those solutions and discloses the earlier grammar-evidence role. Independent composition checks are not substitutes for the later full task/key review.
